newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru ask-only after filing for protection.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru ask-only after filing for protection.

text.p: Kyotaru Co Ltd shares were ask-only in early Monday morning trade, after the sushi restaurant chain operator said it filed for protection from creditors over the weekend, brokers said.
As of 0130 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 485 yen in the first section of the Tokyo bourse, after closing at 510 yen on Friday.

Shares of the firm, which racked up debts totalling 101.3 billion yen from losses in investments and poor business, have been put under surveillance. They will be delisted on April 20, the Tokyo Stock Exchange said in a statement.
